name: Editorial Paper
vibe: Explainer on warm newsprint: paper sheet on top, person below, light-vs-black serif headlines with a highlighter swipe, quiet caps captions.

reference.creator: Nate Herk — herk-edit-kit (MIT), curiosity reel
reference.what: vertical split: beige paper panel top ~50%, person bottom, thin accent rule on the seam, 2-line headline (ink line + accent line), dashed numbered slots, stacked paper card, caps captions with one coloured keyword

reference.creator: Nate Herk — herk-edit-kit style-library/01-vox-explainer
reference.what: Vox type system and texture: Fraunces 300/900 serif, Archivo 700 caps labels (0.16em), Caveat only for margin notes, paper #efe9dc + ink #17130e, faint grid + multiplied grain, highlighter sweep on steps(5), choppy stop-motion entrances

reference.creator: Nate Herk — herk-edit-kit docs/EDITING-PLAYBOOK.md
reference.what: caption rules: 1–3 word caps chunks, one look for the whole reel in a dark box with a thin light edge, colour on whole chunk only, never over mouth/chin, on the seam/shirt

density: One split-paper beat every 8–15 s at turning points (hook, proof, list, ending); 3–5 per minute. Everything between is the plain face with captions. Never two paper beats back to back without face time.
not: not a meme/hype edit: no thick black-stroke words, no emoji, no bouncing captions
not glossy tech: no glass, glow, neon, gradients, blurred drop shadows
not a sans-serif headline style: the statement voice is always Fraunces serif
not pure white or pure black: warm paper + warm ink only

brand.note: brand colour becomes the highlighter swipe and accent rule; serif type stays

fit.good_for: 深度观点、品牌故事、有质感的讲解
fit.avoid: 节奏很快的促销、情绪化的种草
